card: Adds multiprocess support to Bitcoin Core, splitting the node, wallet, and GUI into separate executables communicating over IPC socketpairs via Cap'n Proto. Today, all components run within a single monolithic address space, meaning a vulnerability or crash in GUI or wallet components can compromise consensus validation or the entire node. This PR is the primary milestone of the process separation project (#28722). It depends on #29409 and unblocks followup options for socket binding in #19460 and #19461.
changed_since_previous: Updated the src/ipc/libmultiprocess subtree, added compiler warning suppressions for C++23 lambda attributes, and adjusted RPC timeouts and logging handling in functional tests.
evidence: PR description: "This PR is part of the process separation project (#28722)."

PR description: "adds an --enable-multiprocess configure option which builds new bitcoin-node, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-gui executables with relevant functionality isolated into different processes."
problem: The validating node, wallet, and GUI run within a single shared address space. A memory corruption bug, crash, or dependency vulnerability in GUI or wallet code can compromise the validating node and the entire process.

risk.why: Mistakes in IPC serialization or process lifecycle management could lead to communication deadlocks, RPC hangs, or desynchronized wallet state between processes.

scope_notes: A substantial portion of the diff consists of the src/ipc/libmultiprocess subtree update. It also introduces Cap'n Proto schema definitions (.capnp) along with IPC wrapper implementations, and changes WalletLoader::restoreWallet parameter ordering to meet libmultiprocess output parameter conventions.
summary: Adds multiprocess support to Bitcoin Core, enabling bitcoin-node, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-gui to run as isolated processes communicating over IPC socketpairs using Cap'n Proto. Implements Cap'n Proto IPC wrappers for Node, Wallet, and Init interfaces, configuring bitcoin-gui to spawn a bitcoin-node child process and bitcoin-node to spawn a bitcoin-wallet child process. Also updates the libmultiprocess subtree, adds per-process suffixes to debug logging, and refactors btcsignals callback destruction timing.
